trigger: Some completed GLM responses wrap an otherwise valid JSON object in a single Markdown code fence. Original strict parsing rejects these responses.
observed_before_policy: Availability probes and author transport/parse status; no blinded judgments or preferences inspected.
eligible: Apply identically to every provider. Only pairs not judged in the primary run, with two response_complete author executions, valid report/notes objects after this exact envelope removal, are eligible.
transformation: Remove only one enclosing ```json or ``` Markdown fence around the whole content; json.loads must succeed without any other edits. Do not alter the report or notes strings. No substring extraction, missing-brace repair, rewriting, model retries or budget changes.
judge: Same fresh-context Codex CLI model/settings, original randomized A/B assignments, brief, sources and rubric. Send report text verbatim.
preservation: Keep all primary errors, unresolved results, hashes and raw responses. Store derivations, new judge calls and results in a separate format-supplement directory; never overwrite primary outcomes.
interpretation: Supplementary usability/quality diagnostics only. Do not merge into the prespecified primary preference table or count additional task families.
calls: No new author calls. At most one judge call for each previously unjudged eligible pair; total primary plus supplementary judge calls cannot exceed 20.
